about: From the best passage's P(holds): below 0.32 search_more (on the bench 96% of such items were not fully answered, 77% on reworded twins; ECE 0.18, measured over all items); act 0.99 is out of reach for this scorer (its highest possible P is about 0.94) because no Series One threshold reached even 80% precision for sufficient (near misses score high), so sufficient is never said; between, unsure. Fitted on Library-style passages, applied to recalled conversation turns: refit from shadow receipts before any act. Add only: in act mode it could only add a retrieval step or an I-could-not-find line.
